spans.s:
गुध् गुध्, cl. 4. P. गुध्यति, to wrap up,
envelop, cover, conceal, clothe [cf. गुण्ठ्];
cl. 9. P. गुध्नाति, to be angry; cl. 1. A. गोधते,
to play, sport; [cf. Gr. κεύθω; Germ. haut; Old
Germ. hût; Angl. Sax. hyde, hyd; Lat. cutis?].
गुधित, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, enclosed.

गुधेर, अस्, आ, अम्, protecting, a protector, a
defender; [cf. गुण्ड्.]
